key: D major (with a D-mixolydian bVII colour chord, C major)

stems.vocal: mono, dry processed lead + double (no hall); add to both channels at unity gain
stems.accomp: stereo, instruments + their hall, at mix level
stems.mix: stereo, vocal + vocal hall + accomp, bus-limited (-1.3 dBTP)

notes: times in seconds from the start of each piece; line start/end = first/last sound of the sung line; env = 24 fps mouth envelope from line start; strums = every right-hand lute stroke (strokes has kind/vel); beats = dotted-quarter beats; sections are contiguous.

lines.text: Once upon a time, in a kingdom of stone,
Lived a town full of folk who were living alone.
They had potions for sleeping and charms for the rain,
And a lock on each heart, and a latch on each pane.
Now a dragon lived there with a scarf and a sigh,
And he waved at his neighbours, who hurried on by.
Every merchant in town had a stone he could sell —
But for what he was missing, there wasn't a spell.
So pull up a stool, friend, and hear how it's said:
How a kingdom of stone found its way back to bread.
So if you've a loaf, friend, you know what to do:
Someone's hungry for bread on the bench next to you.
